_comment: Banned strings for scripts/lecture_check.py. 'global' applies to every lecture; 'courses' adds patterns per course folder (the folder the file sits in). Each rule: name, regex (Python), case (true = case-sensitive). 'allowed' lists phrases per course whose surrounding text exempts a hit. Ruling 2026-11-22 06:04: 'the governor on the prime mover' is allowed, so ece-3033 does not ban 'governor'.
